text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the magazine photo shoot. They were supposed to do
a special feature on Seeking the Pearl's racing outfit, but...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text: Looking good, Ms. Pearl! Next, I want to capture the design on the back, so let's have you turn your back while turning your face toward the camera.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~... That's not bad either,
but it feels like something's just not quite right.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text: And by that, you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Showing off the racewear design through photos...
That's great too, of course, but I have a vision I really want to try out!!"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
A vision, is it? If you let me know your requests,
I will reflect them as much as possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Everything should be
challenging! Unprecedented!
I want you to capture an undiscovered brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see...? Specifically, what kind of situation are you hoping for?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, it's a treasure hunt!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by Seeking the Pearl's boundless momentum,
before I knew it, we ended up doing a shoot in the forest...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm going to discover an undiscovered
new plant species in this forest!
Make sure you capture it perfectly on camera!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text: Understood! ...Though, why a treasure hunt in the first place...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Discovering a new species sounds like an exciting challenge, but...
to be honest, wouldn't that be extraordinarily difficult...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true, it won't be easy.
But that's all the more reason! Let's give it a try!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I was hoping it might be a new species,
but no such luck... I've seen this flower before.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We've been walking around searching for hours now...
Will we really be able to find it?
I suppose it was never going to be easy—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, if you give up, it's game over right there!
What matters is having a challenger spirit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A strong conviction to see it through, and believing in yourself are key!
Now then, let's head over to those bushes next!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Nothing around here either.
In that case, let's head deeper! Onward!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you want to go in even deeper...!?
You don't have to go that far... We've got plenty, um, for the article already...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Right, I'm sorry, you're exhausted, aren't you?
Please feel free to rest here, you two.
I'll come right back to let you know if I find anything!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You plan on going alone!?
You must be exhausted too, Pearl-san,
so maybe we should call it a day—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No! I must see this challenge through to the end...
As long as I wear this racing silk!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"A Racewear...? Wh-What kind of meaning
is woven into this Racewear...?! Please, do tell!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You see, it's "Proof of Possibility"!
It's a racewear that expresses my vision
of showing the world what is possible!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The base color, 'Passionate Red,'
represents the passion to pursue every possibility!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And the 'star' on my chest is a guiding, shining
light of hope for everyone—which means, a symbol of potential!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This challenge is all about conveying
the true meaning of a racing outfit to the readers.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "If I give up on searching here, I won't get a photo I'm satisfied with. My feelings won't reach the readers... That's why I must see this through!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Miss Seeking the Pearl...
Um, my apologies! I failed to properly grasp your vision...!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text: We will follow you to the ends of the earth! All to share your challenge with the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thanks, everyone.
I'll definitely find a new species!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "This plant is... quite rare. For it to grow in such large clusters... maybe, just maybe, a new species is mixed in...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
――! This... the leaves on this one are different!
This must be the undiscovered flower!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'll check it right away!
Huh... th-this is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl finally discovered a new species of flower!
Having conquered an exceedingly difficult challenge, she proved what was possible.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to take the final page's photo.
How to convey my vision through this challenge...
choice_data_list: Let's strike a pose that radiates potential!
How about expressing the imagery of the stars?
How about expressing the imagery of the stars?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to take the final page's photo.
How to convey my vision through this challenge...
choice_data_list: Let's strike a pose that radiates potential!
How about expressing the imagery of the stars?
How about expressing the imagery of the stars?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Right, that's the whole point this time.
I want a world where everyone can take on challenges
without fear and without giving up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "...I've decided! Let's go with a pose that speaks directly to the hearts of all our readers!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Next, it's your turn to take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This photo, taken alongside the new flower species Seeking the Pearl discovered, would go on to give courage to countless people.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nice idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To convey the image of a star—
a collab with the starry sky is a must!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, the rest of the shoot
was scheduled to take place at night.”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A star is a light of hope, a symbol of potential...
And this flower is proof of that potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you take on the challenge, the world will open up before anyone! Follow me!
O-ho-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—when the magazine was published, fans were inspired by
Seeking the Pearl shining under the starry sky, sparking huge conversations.
